newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Reading & Bates starts as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Reading & Bates starts as buy.

text.p: --Rodman & Renshaw Inc said on Friday it initiated coverage of Reading & Bates Inc, a deep-water driller, with a buy rating.
--Its EPS estimates for the company are for $1.15 in 1996, $2.25 in 1997 and $2.50 in 1998.
-- EBIDTA is forecast as growing to $240 million in 1997 from $137 million in 1996.
--Rodman also set a price target on the stock at $42.
--Reading & Bates was trading at 28-3/8, off 3/8 in late morning exchange trading.
